snippet.description:
Learn First Order Partial Derivatives in calculus with solved examples, formulas, step-by-step rules, and proofs for B.Sc Maths, B.Tech, and Engineering semester exams in Hindi.

Iss lecture mein hum cover kar rahe hain Partial Differentiation (आंशिक अवकलन) ke First Order Derivatives $\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}, \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)$. Agar aap B.Sc Mathematics, B.Sc B.Ed, B.Tech ya competitive exams jaise IIT JAM ki taiyari kar rahe hain, toh yeh video aapke fundamentals strong karega.

📌 Topics Covered in This Video:
What is Partial Differentiation & Notation 
Rule of keeping independent variables constant
Detailed solved examples:
3-variable determinant proof
Proof of symmetric functions and algebraic expressions

📌 Timestamps
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Partial Differentiation
02:25 - Example 1(i)
06:33 - Example 1(ii)
09:40 - Example 1(iii)
13:57 - Example 2
18:57 - Example 3: Determinant Form Proof 
27:10 - Example 4: Algebraic Function Proof involving 
37:44 - Summary & Overview of Second Order Partial Derivatives

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:

🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths
